headlines.text: Nvidia confirms Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO effective immediately amid affair/espionage probe; CFO Colette Kress named interim chief
Nvidia board weighs internal pick Ian Buck and outside names like AMD's Lisa Su and Arm's Rene Haas for permanent CEO
Nvidia shares swing as much as 6-12% as Huang's abrupt exit rattles the AI trade, pressuring S&P 500 and Nasdaq
AMD jumps ~3%, Broadcom surges as much as 6% as investors rotate into Nvidia's AI-chip rivals amid leadership chaos
Red-hot core CPI keeps December Fed rate-hike odds elevated after Chair Warsh declines to rule out another increase
Analysts warn Nvidia's leaderless transition risks shareholder returns, citing lack of a clear succession plan
